headline: Rs 25 increase in wheat MSP is injustice to farmers: Bhardwaj - dainiktribuneonline.com
summary: Former MLA Shiv Shankar Bhardwaj called the Rs 25 per quintal rise in the wheat minimum support price an injustice to farmers. He said they should receive a fair price for their crops.
why: The minimum support price is the government-set floor price for crops such as wheat in India. It influences farm incomes, procurement and food inflation.
